title: E3 rerun with the BSIM4 u0 unit-switch fix: learned shared temperature law vs parametric law
status: pre-registered before any E3b run; the smoke run (runs/smoke) is a pipeline check and is not a decision input
relation_to_E3: The E3 verdict KILL (queue job E3_full_M, out/research/explore/E3/runs/full) stands and is not revised by E3b.

E3b is a new probe. It is motivated by the I2-0 diagnosis (out/research/explore/I2_0/diagnosis.md, part B): E3 tier-M truths and fitted cards could cross the BSIM4 u0 > 1 unit switch (BSIM4 reads u0 > 1 as cm^2/Vs and divides it by 1e4); the test device nmos_L1_W3__2 had truth u0 above 1 at 77-110 K and every method gave RRMS 676-1060 in its 110 K cell.
The decision rule below is the E3 rule copied without change. It was not changed after seeing the I2-0 without-device diagnostic (part C: E3 rule output CONTINUE without nmos_L1_W3__2).

source_prereg.addendum: out/research/explore/E3/prereg_addendum.json (sha256 d2ec12bd32d63d03384ceb82e84a2b078f24e465cd979b24528843994f818db3); its implementation changes (zero-initialised NetLaw output layer, lrn_noH skipped on a grid without non-anchor temperatures) remain in effect and its review notes apply to E3b.

copied_from_E3_prereg_verbatim.hypothesis: On simulated 77-300 K devices whose truth has a temperature law outside the fitted parametric family (logistic knee + bump, nonzero 300 K offset, extrinsic series resistance with linear temperature coefficient), a temperature law learned from a densely characterised device population and shared across devices (MLP on per-temperature 7-parameter fits, sensitivity-weighted loss) predicts the 7-parameter card at held-out temperatures 110/190/260 K with lower NGSpice RRMS than the parametric law x(T) = c + (mu - c) w(T)^g fitted per device (O4) or with population-pooled g (O2).

data_protocol.real_devices: No real I-V is used. Only REAL_DEV geometries (out/research/explore/real_split.json) are used as simulated device geometries; REAL_TEST geometries are rejected by the script.
data_protocol.world: src/cryoml/explore/e3_temp.py: SkyWater 77 K corner bin, tnom = 27 C, seven paper parameters numeric per temperature, x = log(p/p_stock).
data_protocol.tier_M: x(T) = c + (mu - c) s(T) + b 4w(1-w); s = normalised logistic in T with device knee U[120,230] K (+-25 K per parameter), width U[10,35] K; c ~ U(+-0.05) vth0, U(+-0.10) others; b ~ U(+-0.05) vth0, U(+-0.15) u0 and rdsw, 0 others; extrinsic drain and source resistors R(T) = R300 (1 + alpha (T - 300.15 K)), R300 = U[0.3,1.0] * rdsw_stock / (2 W), alpha ~ U[0.002, 0.0035]/K. mu uniform in the 0.75x cold-loop round-4 anchor box.
data_protocol.tier_W: x(T) = mu w(T)^g, g log-uniform [1/3, 3] (secondary check only).
data_protocol.training_population: n_train = 6 truth draws per REAL_DEV geometry (72 devices), each observed on the dense grid 77,90,100,110,130,150,170,190,210,225,245,260,280,300 K; per-temperature 7-parameter NGSpice fits (LM, batched FD Jacobians, bank-screened starts) give x_hat(T) and H(T) = J^T J.
data_protocol.test_population: n_test = 3 truth draws per REAL_DEV geometry (36 devices), different random stream; observed at O4 = {77,150,225,300} K or O2 = {77,300} K; scored at held-out H = {110,190,260} K.

methods.par3: per-device law x = c + (mu - c) w^g (21 numbers) fitted jointly on NGSpice to the observed temperatures (LM, chain-rule Jacobian, init from per-temperature fits). O4 primary control.
methods.par14: cryoml.temperature family (c = 0, free g) fitted the same way. O4 secondary control.
methods.par3_pop: law with g_k pooled over the training population (H-weighted grid search), per-device mu and c fitted on NGSpice. O2 primary control; O4 secondary.
methods.pt_interp: linear interpolation in T of the per-temperature anchor fits (no learning).
methods.lrn: PRIMARY learned method: x(T) = x_lin(T) + phi_O(T) sigma MLP(geometry, anchors, T); 2x64 SiLU, 5-seed ensemble, loss d^T Hn d + 0.1 mean((d/sigma)^2), Hn = 7H/tr(H); trained on all non-anchor dense temperatures of the training population.
methods.lrn_param, lrn_noH, lrn_mean: secondary: parameter-MSE loss; training without 110/190/260 K; population-mean correction per device type (no network).
methods.floor: per-temperature 7-parameter fit at each held-out temperature using held-out data (reference for gap closure only, not a method).

copied_from_E3_prereg_verbatim.metric: Per (device, held-out temperature): frozen-inclusion paper RRMS (published-baseline included curve set, curve_trim on the truth target) of the NGSpice re-simulated card against the simulated truth curves, mean over included curves; strict: any non-finite included curve makes the cell NaN. Per device: mean over 110/190/260 K. Aggregate: all-device mean over the 36 tier-M test devices (devices finite for all compared methods).
copied_from_E3_prereg_verbatim.primary_comparison: R_S = 1 - mean(lrn) / mean(control_S) for S in {O4 (control par3), O2 (control par3_pop)}, paired percentile bootstrap over test devices (4000 resamples).

criterion.CONTINUE: for at least one S: R_S >= 0.25 AND bootstrap 95% CI lower bound of R_S > 0 AND lrn reduces held-out RRMS by >= 10% vs pt_interp in the same S AND failed-cell fraction <= 10% for lrn, control_S and pt_interp.
criterion.KILL: R_S < 0.10 for both S, OR lrn is worse than pt_interp (reduction < 0) for both S.
criterion.INCONCLUSIVE: otherwise; one revision allowed only with a new pre-registration file.
secondary_reported_not_decisive: tier W run E3_full_W: lrn held-out RRMS vs par3/par3_pop (expect parametric to win; reported)
lrn vs lrn_mean (does the network add over a population-mean shape)
lrn_noH vs lrn (dependence on training at the held-out temperatures)

known_limitations: The learned law is trained on devices from the same generator as the test devices; the result measures transfer within a population whose law is shared, not transfer to a different physical law.
Parameter fits at non-anchor temperatures are themselves misspecified (series R absorbed by rdsw), so floor > 0 on tier M.

settings.decision_run: queue job E3b_full_M: tier M, all 12 REAL_DEV geometries, n_train 6, n_test 3, dense grid 77,90,100,110,130,150,170,190,210,225,245,260,280,300 K, seed 20261019, law_iter 15, learn_seeds 5, workers 8. The decision is made once on this run.
settings.secondary_run: queue job E3b_full_W: same settings, tier W (reported, not decisive; as E3_full_W).
settings.output: out/research/explore/E3b/runs/full/tier_M and tier_W (E3 outputs under out/research/explore/E3 are not overwritten)

a_u0_fix.code: src/cryoml/explore/e3_temp.py (patch out/research/explore/I2_0/proposed_e3_u0_switch.patch plus helper functions u0_upper_x, at_or_above_u0_switch, clip_u0, truth_u0_max)
a_u0_fix.switch: x_u0 at which the card value |u0| = 1: u0_switch_x = log(1 / |u0_stock|).
a_u0_fix.truth_draws: draw_truth rejects a draw whose x_u0 is at or above u0_switch_x - 0.02 at any dense temperature and draws again from the same generator stream (at most 50 attempts; the number of rejected draws is stored in the truth as u0_switch_rejections).
a_u0_fix.fit_bounds: x_bounds: upper bound of x_u0 = min(previous bound, u0_switch_x - 0.02). This changes the bound for nmos_L1_W3 (4.874 -> 3.635) and nmos_L0p25_W1p6 (4.213 -> 3.638); the other 10 geometries keep their bounds. The forward FD step (0.01) from the bound stays below the switch. All other parameters and bounds are unchanged.
a_u0_fix.law_and_interpolation_cards: par3, par14, par3_pop, par3_g1, par14_g1 predict x(T) = c + (mu - c) w^g with mu and c inside the fit bounds and w^g in [0, 1], and pt_interp interpolates fitted anchors linearly; both stay inside the bounds without a clip.
a_u0_fix.learned_cards: lrn, lrn_param, lrn_noH and lrn_mean add phi_O(T) sigma correction(T) to the linear interpolation; this is not bounded. In E3b the x_u0 of every evaluated card (every method, every test temperature) is clipped to the x_u0 upper fit bound before NGSpice evaluation. Only x_u0 and only its upper side are changed. The clip is a no-op for fitted, law and interpolation cards. The number of clipped cards per setting and method is recorded (u0_switch_check.json, summary.json u0_switch_check.n_evaluated_cards_u0_clipped). preds.json stores the predictions before the clip.

b_regenerated_truths.rule: Truths for tiers M and W are drawn with the patched draw_truth from the E3 streams (seed 20261019, rng [seed, tier, split, geometry index, draw]). A draw that does not cross the switch is identical to the E3 draw; only crossing draws are replaced.
b_regenerated_truths.known_before_run: Computed from the generator without NGSpice. Tier M: 4 truths regenerated (train nmos_L1_W3 draws 1, 2, 3; test nmos_L1_W3 draw 2) with 7 rejected draws in total (1, 1, 2, 3). Tier W: 2 truths regenerated (train nmos_L1_W3 draw 2; test nmos_L1_W3 draw 0) with 2 rejected draws (1, 1). The other 104 truths per tier are unchanged.
b_regenerated_truths.output_names: queue jobs E3b_full_M and E3b_full_W; directory out/research/explore/E3b/runs/full/tier_M and tier_W.

c_switch_assertion.checked: every training and test truth at every dense temperature; every per-temperature fitted card (training fits, test O4, O2 and floor fits); every predicted card (counted before the clip); every evaluated card (after the clip).
c_switch_assertion.condition: x_u0 >= u0_switch_x (card u0 at or above 1).
c_switch_assertion.recorded: counts per category in out/research/explore/E3b/runs/<name>/tier_<T>/u0_switch_check.json and summary.json u0_switch_check, with the number of rejected and regenerated truth draws.
c_switch_assertion.validity: The run is valid only if 0 truths, 0 fitted cards and 0 evaluated cards are at or above the switch. If the check fails, summary.json verdict_rule_output is INVALID (the rule output computed on the run is kept under verdict_rule_output_if_valid). An INVALID run is not counted as CONTINUE, KILL or INCONCLUSIVE.

d_secondary_paired_statistic.definition: For S in {O4 (control par3), O2 (control par3_pop)}: per test device, ratio lrn / control_S of the held-out per-device RRMS (mean over 110/190/260 K), on the devices finite for lrn, control_S and pt_interp. Reported: geometric mean of the ratios exp(mean log ratio), paired percentile bootstrap 95% CI over test devices (4000 resamples, seed 0), and the number of devices with lrn < control_S (wins).
d_secondary_paired_statistic.note: Reported, not a decision input. The decision uses only the copied E3 criterion.

unchanged: Hypothesis, data protocol (except the truth rejection), methods, metric, primary comparison, CONTINUE/KILL/INCONCLUSIVE rule, settings (n_train 6, n_test 3, dense grid, seed, law_iter 15, learn_seeds 5) and the driver stages are the same as E3.
